build_llm_with_hidden_state_extraction: build a vLLM model with speculative config to extract hidden states from specific transformer layers
run_generate_with_speculative_decoding: run generation with extract_hidden_states speculator method to capture intermediate hidden states from prompts
create_sampling_params: create sampling parameters with max tokens set to one for single token generation
extract_hidden_states_from_safetensors: extract token ids and hidden states tensors from a safetensors file using safe_open
retrieve_hidden_states_path_from_output: retrieve the hidden states file path from kv_transfer_params after LLM generation
